# netactuate_vpc_locations (Data Source)

Reads VPC Locations visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_vpc_locations" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `locations` (List of Object) Locations where VPCs can be created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
